identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open and Single Dose-escalation Study to Evaluate the Safety and Clinical Activity of Allogeneic CAR-T Targeting CD22(ThisCART22) in Patients With Relapsed and/or Refractory Non-Hodgkin's B Cell Lymphoma (r/r B-NHL)

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: ThisCART22 cell is a non-gene-editing allogeneic CAR-T cell targeting CD22. This study is designed to evaluate the safety and clinical activity of ThisCART22 in patients with CD22 positive, relapsed and/or refractory non-Hodgkin's B cell lymphoma (r/r B-NHL).

primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of adverse events as assessed by NCI-CTCAE 5.0

secondaryOutcomes.description: The interval between administration and disease progression or death
The interval between administration and death caused by any reason
EFS is calculated from administration to death, progression of the disease, relapse or gene recurrence, whichever comes first, or last visit.
